entries.reason: Static test review found missing coverage for plugin help CLI surfaces, locale fallback behavior, and import-time side-effect documentation.
entries.trigger: senti flow run review --phase test returned FAIL with three blocking findings.
entries.resolution: Added plugin CLI help surface coverage for senti help <plugin> and direct plugin --help, added unsupported-locale fallback assertion, and added documentation-policy assertion.
entries.guardrailCandidate: Spec-local tests must cover every concrete public surface and every compound requirement clause, not only the primary runtime path.

entries.reason: Second static test review found self-referential core help coverage and insufficient renderer-owner observability in spec-local tests.
entries.trigger: senti flow run review --phase test returned FAIL after the first test repair.
entries.resolution: Added an explicit existing core help command baseline, args/subcommands metadata assertions, and a renderer-backed surface owner assertion.
entries.guardrailCandidate: Migration parity tests must compare against an explicit legacy public surface baseline, not only against newly generated model output.

entries.reason: Third static test review found that R6, R2, R3, R7, and R9 tests still did not exercise the specific migration risks.
entries.trigger: senti flow run review --phase test returned FAIL with five blocking findings after the second repair.
entries.resolution: Added registry-only render fixture, deeper command help parity assertions, non-help dispatcher execution and owner assertions, core R7 surfaces, and an unlisted plugin command file check.
entries.guardrailCandidate: Expected-fail tests should directly exercise the risk surface and include an implementation-owned observable, not just current behavior that may already pass.

entries.reason: Fourth static test review found missing R6 coverage for plugin hook dispatch preservation.
entries.trigger: senti flow run review --phase test returned FAIL with one blocking finding after the third repair.
entries.resolution: Added a plugin hook fixture, discovered the hook snapshot, invoked runFlowCommandHooks, and asserted hook dispatch output plus execution-owner metadata.
entries.guardrailCandidate: When a requirement lists multiple ownership surfaces, spec-local tests must include focused coverage for each named surface.

entries.reason: Fifth static test review found loose migration parity assertions, missing plugin namespace help coverage, and narrow execution ownership checks.
entries.trigger: senti flow run review --phase test returned FAIL with three blocking findings after plugin hook coverage was added.
entries.resolution: Added explicit retained help content expectations, plugin namespace help invocation coverage, docs non-help execution, and plugin command args plus failure exit-code assertions.
entries.guardrailCandidate: Migration parity tests should assert retained content and execution semantics with concrete expected values for each public surface.

entries.reason: Sixth static test review found R12 core subcommand help surface coverage was grouped and ambiguous.
entries.trigger: senti flow run review --phase test returned FAIL with one blocking finding after parity and execution checks were added.
entries.resolution: Split R12 core help assertions into explicit global, command-topic, subcommand-topic, namespace --help, and leaf --help test cases with expected topics.
entries.guardrailCandidate: Public surface mapping tests should use one explicit assertion per invocation shape when a requirement enumerates concrete CLI forms.

entries.reason: Seventh static test review found R8 side-effect coverage only exercised model construction, not help rendering.
entries.trigger: senti flow run review --phase test returned FAIL with one blocking R8 finding after R12 was split.
entries.resolution: Extended the R8 fake command test to call renderCommandHelp with fake metadata and assert lazy command import remains uninvoked.
entries.guardrailCandidate: Side-effect tests for read-only rendering must execute the actual renderer path, not just metadata model construction.

entries.reason: Eighth static test review found plugin R12 help-surface tests did not assert renderer-backed ownership.
entries.trigger: senti flow run review --phase test returned FAIL with one plugin R12 blocking finding after R8 renderer coverage was added.
entries.resolution: Added resolveHelpSurfaceOwner assertions for plugin namespace help, plugin command topic help, and direct plugin --help surfaces.
entries.guardrailCandidate: For renderer migration requirements, CLI output assertions should be paired with an owner/path assertion for every legacy-compatible help surface.

entries.reason: Ninth static test review found the parity helper used fragile regex escaping in spec-local tests.
entries.trigger: senti flow run review --phase test returned FAIL with one blocking assertion-helper finding.
entries.resolution: Replaced regex-based expected-fragment checks with direct String.includes assertions for literal help content.
entries.guardrailCandidate: Spec-local parity helpers should prefer literal includes checks when regex matching is not required.

entries.reason: Tenth static test review found missing plugin subcommand public help coverage and a vacuous R10 header test.
entries.trigger: senti flow run review --phase test returned FAIL with two blocking findings after regex helper cleanup.
entries.resolution: Added plugin subcommand owner and CLI help assertions, and replaced the R10 no-op with a static scan of spec-local test headers and R-N test names.
entries.guardrailCandidate: Requirement-header tests must inspect actual files, and plugin help parity must include subcommand public CLI surfaces.

entries.reason: Eleventh static test review found R2, top-level locale, core import-time side effect, and plugin import-time side effect gaps.
entries.trigger: senti flow run review --phase test returned FAIL with four blocking findings after R10 and plugin subcommand coverage were added.
entries.resolution: Added customized existing-command metadata rendering, top-level locale and fallback assertions, temp command import side-effect marker checks, and plugin command top-level import side-effect marker checks.
entries.guardrailCandidate: Renderer migration tests must prove metadata changes drive output and that help rendering does not import command implementation modules.

entries.reason: Twelfth static test review found the R6 docs changelog non-help execution assertion depended on an undeclared .tmp output path.
entries.trigger: senti flow run review --phase test returned FAIL with one clean-environment fixture finding.
entries.resolution: Added explicit .tmp directory and output fixture file setup before invoking docs changelog --dry-run.
entries.guardrailCandidate: Spec-local command tests must create every file path they pass to a command unless the path is guaranteed by the repository.

entries.guardrailCandidate: Plugin package help tests must distinguish package-id surfaces from command-name help surfaces.

entries.guardrailCandidate: Migration tests should assert both public output and the internal ownership boundary required by the spec.
